summary: Frontend regression verified for VLen EMR patient appointment booking. All 6 requested behaviours pass: (1) September 2026 calendar disabled Sep 21/22/23 (backend fully booked=0 slots) and enabled Sep 24 (9 slots) & Sep 28 (1 slot); (2) Sep 24 renders exactly 9 time slot buttons (data-testid appt-time-11:30..16:00); disabled days cannot be selected; (3) Full flow reachable via vertical scroll at 375/390/430 px with NO horizontal overflow (docW==clientW) and calendar not clipped; (4) End-to-end booking on 390px pick Sep24 -> 12:00 -> Follow-Up -> submit produced new 'Appointment Requested' card (APT-000084) with success toast; (5) Cache safety confirmed: GET /api/availability/slots is re-issued on page open (1), on next-month click (1), on previous-month click (1), on pickDate (1), and pre-submit (1); (6) All availability calls hit the same REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host (visita-admin.preview.emergentagent.com/api/availability/slots) - no locally-generated slots.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalAppointments.jsx: `pickDate` triggers slotsQ.refetch() on every day click; combined with staleTime:0 + refetchOnMount:'always' this is correct for cache safety but adds one extra network call per click. Consider debouncing if this becomes a load concern.

The date button strict-mode filter has_text=str(d) can accidentally match same-numbered days from adjacent months (rdp-day_outside). Component behaviour is fine (outside days are also disabled by matcher), but future tests should filter out outside days explicitly.

They appear as 'Appointment Requested' cards. Sep 24 slot count in backend now reduced from 9 -> 7 (two more confirmed) - next tester should re-check available slot counts against latest backend state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar uses react-day-picker; caption text is at [data-testid='appt-calendar'] #react-day-picker-2 (or first .text-sm.font-medium inside the caption). Nav buttons use button[name='previous-month'] / button[name='next-month'] (NOT .rdp-nav_button_next). Day buttons use button[name='day'] and adjacent-month days have class 'rdp-day_outside' - always exclude when matching by day number. appt-reason/appt-note/appt-review/appt-submit are only rendered AFTER selecting both a date AND a time. Seed data: after these iterations Sep 24 has fewer open slots (was 9, now ~7); Sep 28 had 1 slot. Do NOT test the deployed production URL - preview only.
rca of the issue: N/A - no regressions. The reported fix (real backend availability + mobile layout + cache safety) is working correctly at 375, 390 and 430 px viewport widths.
